A [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Mandalorian]] was a lead '''warrior''' of [[Clan Rook]]. She pledged her [[Mandalorian clan|clan]] to the [[Mandalorian resistance]] led by [[Lady]] [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] during the [[Mandalorian Civil War (Imperial Era)|Mandalorian Civil War]]. The warrior was equipped with [[Color|gray]] [[Mandalorian armor]] with yellow and purple highlights and two [[blaster pistol]]s.

==Biography==
The [[Mandalorian]] [[Gender|woman]] was a member of [[Clan Rook]] and served as a lead [[Soldier|warrior]] for the [[Mandalorian clan]].<ref name="HoM" /> In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="date2BBY">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Legacy of Mandalore]]" to [[2 BBY]].</ref> the [[Mandalorian Civil War (Imperial Era)|Mandalorian Civil War]] broke out between the [[Mandalorian]]s with [[Clan Wren]] [[Skirmish on Krownest|rising up]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]–aligned [[Clan Saxon]] and [[Imperial Super Commando]]s.<ref name="LoM">{{Rebels|Legacy of Mandalore}}</ref> About a year later,<ref name="date1BBY">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Heroes of Mandalore|Star Wars Rebels: Heroes of Mandalore]]'' to [[1 BBY]].</ref> [[Sabine Wren]] led the successful [[Mission to Mandalore]], with the help of [[Clan Kryze]], to rescue [[Alrich Wren|her father]] from Clan Saxon custody. The mission saw the destruction of Imperial [[superweapon]] [[Arc Pulse Generator|"the Duchess"]] and the [[death]] of [[Governor]] [[Tiber Saxon]]. In response, the lead Clan Rook warrior pledged her own clan to [[Lady]] [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] and the Mandalorian resistance against the Galactic Empire along with several other Mandalorian factions.<ref name="HoM" />

==Personality and traits==
The Mandalorian warrior was a [[human]] female who had [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s and dark skin. She spoke in a serious and confident manner, having committed her clan against the Galactic Empire. When Sabine Wren gave Bo-Katan Kryze the [[Darksaber]], a symbolic weapon important in Mandalorian history, the lead warrior of Clan Rook gave a hopeful smile as she looked on.<ref name="HoM" />

==Equipment==
The Clan Rook warrior carried two Mandalorian [[blaster pistol]]s and a [[jetpack]]. Additionally, she [[Clothing|wore]] a set of [[Mandalorian vambrace]]s,<ref name="BTS-Gal">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/heroes-of-mandalore-episode-guide|text="Heroes of Mandalore" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}}</ref> a device designed to combat the skills of a [[Jedi]].<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|mandalorian-vambraces|Mandalorian Vambraces}}</ref>

As a warrior of Clan Rook, she wore a set of [[Mandalorian armor]] featuring the symbol of her clan in [[Color|purple]]. This type of [[armor]] was made of [[beskar]],<ref name="HoM" /> a [[steel]] alloy<ref name="Mando3">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 3: The Sin}}</ref> commonly used by all Mandalorian clans.<ref name="PoCD">{{Rebels|The Protector of Concord Dawn}}</ref> Her particular armor was grey with yellow and purple highlights, which was typical for members of her clan.<ref name="HoM" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ClanRookLeader-ConceptArt.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Concept art for the warrior]]
First being shown in the second trailer for [[Star Wars Rebels Season Four|Season 4 of ''Rebels'']],<ref name="Trail2">{{SWYouTube|JtigV-biVGg|Star Wars Rebels Season 4 Trailer 2 (Official)|sw_url=video/star-wars-rebels-season-4-trailer-2}}</ref> Clan Rook and the warrior subsequently appeared in the premiere of [[Star Wars Rebels Season Four|the fourth season]] of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'', titled ''[[Heroes of Mandalore|Star Wars Rebels: Heroes of Mandalore]]'', which aired in [[2017]]. She appears alongside several other members of her clan in the final scene of the episode.<ref name="HoM" />

According to [[Amy Beth Christenson]], every designer had to draft several Mandalorian armor variations for the scene while ensuring each individual Mandalorian looked similar to their fellow clan members.<ref name="RebelsRecon">{{SWYouTube|6JoAwwYtsHc|Rebels Recon #4.1: Inside Heroes of Mandalore, Parts 1 and 2 | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/disneyxd-rebels-recon-inside-heroes-of-mandalore}}</ref> The concept art for the lead Clan Rook warrior was drafted by [[Luke Harrington]] on [[May 3]], [[2016]]. Originally, the character had blue eyes instead of brown.<ref name="BTS-Gal" />

She is voiced by [[Bonnie Wild]] and credited as "Lead Rook Warrior."<ref name="HoM" /> Wild was a frequent sound editor and re-recording mixer for the series while working at [[Skywalker Sound]].<ref name="Skywalker-Sound">{{SkySound|url=projects/star-wars-rebels|text=Star Wars: Rebels|archiveurl=https://archive.is/r5qTE}}</ref>
